maya_cs: Quick sync note from onboarding with Atlas Co. They raised three small-but-critical asks that are blocking their internal rollout: route spend alerts, short-context embedding recipe pack, and per-route monthly export for finance. Said they'll pause expansion until fixed.

ryan_pm: Can you paste one concrete example and how often they hit this? Need to know impact on renewal.

maya_cs: Example: one dev ran a bulk job and a single route consumed ~120k tokens overnight; finance spotted unexpected $8k charge. They mentioned quota/export confusion 4x in the onboarding sessions.

zoe_support: Uploaded chat + 22s console clip: https://support.example.com/AT-211. Workaround is client throttling but it's fragile.

chet_research: Quick triage: alerts = high impact, medium effort. recipe pack = low dev, big UX win. export = low effort, medium impact. Scoring heuristic I use: (ARR_exposed * mentions) / dev_days.

devon_pdm: Drop one-line descriptions so I can make PRD stubs. Also flag any cross-billing or compliance issues.

maya_cs: route spend alerts: "Alert (email+webhook) when route token spend exceeds X% of monthly quota + optional soft block."
recipe pack: "Ship 5 embedding prompt+preprocessing recipes for <=128 token contexts with example evals."
route export: "CSV export of monthly per-route token/spend + quick-download button on Console."

ryan_pm: Zoe/Chet — quick T-shirt sizes by EOD? I'll open tickets and link the CS threads. @alert-bot attach artifacts.

alert-bot: Created TKT-1201 (route-alerts), TKT-1202 (embed-recipes), TKT-1203 (route-export). Linked AT-211.
